neighbours.label: the slot where a limb word is expected in amputation / prosthetics contexts ('lost a [leg]', 'prost|hetic')
fire: The landmine went off under the truck and the driver lost a foot.
Years after the frostbite he still walks on a prosthetic foot.
The veteran trains every day on his new running prosthesis.
Diabetes complications meant she had to lose a toe and then a leg.
The surgeons had no choice but to amputate below the knee.
Children who lose a limb often adapt to their artificial legs quickly.
The sprinter competes on a pair of curved carbon blades in place of legs.
After the shark attack the surfer was left without a right arm.
quiet: The stock market went down under the news and the investor lost a fortune.
Years after the divorce he still walks past their old house.
The veteran trains every day for his next marathon.
Bad luck meant she had to lose a game and then a match.
The surgeons had no choice but to operate on the heart.
Children who lose a pet often adapt to a new puppy quickly.
The sprinter competes on a curved indoor track in the winter.
After the long trip the surfer was left without a working car.

notes: Card: 'pair of [carbon fiber prosthetic legs]', 'prost|hetic', 'lose a [leg]'; logit promotes leg/limb/prost. Probe: 'lost a [leg]' after an accident 1.08, 'lost a hand' 0.74, 'lost a fortune' 0.10. Near misses keep 'lost a' / injury setting without a limb.
